neighbours.label: A modifier that starts the name of a kind of study or written report, predicting a plural head like 'studies' or 'reports' ('case' studies, 'research' reports, Environmental 'Impact' Statements, 'Literary' Essays); the same sentences naming the document without such a modifier stay quiet.
fire: The course is built around business case studies.
Interns write market research reports every quarter.
The council published an environmental impact assessment.
Her collected literary essays appeared in 1990.
Teachers use field trip reports to grade students.
The journal prints clinical trial results each month.
We read three feasibility studies before deciding.
Students present science fair projects in May.
quiet: The course is built around lectures and seminars.
Interns write short summaries every quarter.
The council published a new plan for the river.
Teachers use quizzes to grade students.
The journal prints new articles each month.
We read three books before deciding.
Students present their posters in May.

notes: Card: no single token (' research', ' case', ' meta', ' Science', ' Impact', ' Literary': 8th Grade⟦ Science⟧ Experiments; essays,⟦ research⟧ reports; Environmental⟦ Impact⟧ Statements; a series of⟦ case⟧ studies); output promotes ' analyses', ' studies', ' reports'. Exploratory probe: case studies 0.62, research reports 0.67, Impact Statements 0.55, 'a research report' 0.44; 'a long story' 0.004.
